name: What site preparation is necessary before a tiny home can be delivered and installed?

mainEntity.name: What site preparation is necessary before a tiny home can be delivered and installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before delivery and installation of your custom tiny home, proper site preparation is crucial. This typically involves ensuring a level foundation, which could be a concrete slab, pier, or skid foundation, depending on the home's design and local regulations. Utility connections, such as water, sewer/septic, and electrical, must also be pre-installed and accessible at the site. We provide detailed guidance on site preparation requirements specific to your chosen home design and location.
